subject: SkyForge demo — replan after infra outage / travel conflicts
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>, Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

Hi Jordan / Maria / team,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical demo focused on production inference reliability (latency SLOs, model fallbacks, and KV/prefix caching) and a short contract/procurement sync for next steps.

Proposed technical deep-dive: Thursday, May 21 at 10:00 AM BST (11:00 CEST / 02:00 PDT) — 75 minutes
Proposed procurement sync (30 min): Friday, May 22 at 14:00 BST

Attendees from our side: myself (AE), Dylan (SE, demo lead), Dev (solutions engineer, architecture/PKI questions). Please let us know alternative windows if those conflict. I attached an updated demo agenda and SSO checklist we typically use for infra/security reviews.

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf, sso-checklist.xlsx

Goal for the session: validate performance under SkyForge's expected 10–50 TPS load pattern and confirm SSO/KMS constraints so we can finalize the Dedicated sizing and the procurement timeline.

Thanks — I can send calendar invites once we lock a time.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

Hi Stephanie,

Appreciate the agenda — looks good. Quick heads up: we have a planned data-center maintenance window on May 21 that will affect our test cluster (and some of our engineers will be on-call). That rules out the 21st for the tech deep-dive.

Two questions / proposals:
- Could we move the technical deep-dive to May 24 or 26? Either works for our infra team depending on travel.
- Procurement will be tied up with quarter-end approvals; procurement only has availability starting the week of May 27. If procurement needs to see pricing/commitment numbers beforehand, let us know what you need and we can prioritize.

Maria (security) — I'm looping you so you can confirm whether the SSO/KMS checklist is sufficient and whether a separate security-only session is needed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee | Lead Engineer, SkyForge Systems
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

Thanks Jordan — that makes sense.

Proposal to keep momentum while accommodating the outage and procurement calendar:
- Technical deep-dive (eng + security): one session on either May 24 OR May 26 (75 min). We can do a focused run with Dylan leading the live demo and Dev on call for architecture/PKI questions.
- Procurement / commercial sync: week of May 27 (we can do May 28 if that works).

If Dev is unavailable on a proposed date, Dylan can run the demo and Dev can join the post-demo Q&A. Recording is an option for follow-up.

If that plan works I will: 1) send separate calendar invites for the two sessions, 2) share a short preread with load profile and test plan, and 3) prep the SSO checklist items you flagged.

Thanks — will wait for confirmation on preferred tech slot (24 vs 26).

—Stephanie
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>, Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

Hey team,

Heads-up — I have travel for an on-site customer visit from May 23–25 and will be offline for those specific windows. I can do May 26 though. If you prefer to keep May 24, Dylan can lead the live walkthrough and I can join the post-demo Q&A (or hop on via phone for the final 20 minutes).

I recommend we also capture a short recording of the run so I can annotate any architecture questions afterwards. For security questions (Maria) I can prepare an architecture diagram and KMS/SAML notes beforehand.

—Dev
Dev Patel | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>
Cc: Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

I can run the May 24 session if that helps — I’ll follow Stephanie’s agenda and make sure we cover fallbacks, autoscaling behavior, and the KV/prefix caching demo.

Contingency plan:
- If Dev is on travel, we run the live demo with me driving and record it.
- Schedule a 45 minute follow-up at least a week later where Dev can deep-dive into PKI and the SSO/KMS specifics with Maria.

Timezone note: Jordan — could you confirm whether your team is UK-based (BST) or CET for the calendar invite? I want to avoid the typical DST confusion.

—Dylan
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyforge.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Torres <maria.torres@skyforge.io>, procurement@skyforge.io
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 08:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SkyForge: inference reliability demo — proposed May 21

Thanks all — plan sounds good. Confirming:
- Tech deep-dive: Tuesday, May 26 at 10:00 AM BST (75 minutes) — Dylan to lead, Dev to join remotely as available.
- Procurement/commercial: Thursday, May 28 at 15:00 BST (30 minutes).

Maria: please confirm the security attendees for the May 26 session.

Stephanie — can you send two calendar invites (26 May tech deep-dive, 28 May procurement) and include the preread and link to the recording after the session? Also please add the HubSpot record HS-34567 to the invites.

Jordan
